lead.headline: Bulls Bench Drops 63, Chicago Rolls Cleveland 122-108
lead.subhead: Jordan Hawkins scored a season-high 19, Buddy Hield added 17 and Tre Jones had 16 and nine assists. A 45-20 second quarter built a 72-50 halftime lead; when Cleveland pushed back, the Bulls closed it with a 10-0 run. Depth wins. Be the whole bench today.

articles.body: Evan McPherson's 56-yarder put Cincinnati up with 46 seconds left. Jayden Daniels answered with two deep throws and Drew Stevens hit a 26-yard kick as time expired. Burrow threw for 300 and two scores and still lost. Forty-six seconds is plenty of time.

New beta agents review pull requests, fix CI failures and, under team rules, approve routine changes, with humans still signing off where required. The bots are moving from writing code to shipping it.

openingBell.title: The Opening Bell
openingBell.intro: Tuesday, Mars's day. Four counts in, four hold, four out, four hold. Mars is the warrior's planet: you don't wait to feel ready, you move and get ready on the way.

breathing.title: Box Breathing — 4 · 4 · 4 · 4

phases.label: INHALE
phases.cue: Draw in through the nose — even, quiet, full.

phases.label: HOLD
phases.cue: Stillness at the top. No strain. Own the pause.

phases.label: HOLD
phases.cue: Empty and steady. Reset the line.

breathing.close: Four rounds squares the mind. Eyes open. Shoulders down. Body next. Then go build.

mindset.body: The Bears didn't play clean yesterday. They won anyway, five in a row, 8-2. Murray put up 45 and needed every one of the eight he scored in overtime. Nobody remembers how pretty it was. They remember who finished. Three work days this week: ship one real 7EightMade piece before Wednesday ends. Competitive. Unbeatable. Always rising. fall down 7 stand up 8.

bodyOpener.title: 3-Minute Opener
bodyOpener.note: Tuesday, Mars's day: run this right after Morning Charge. It's clear and about 26 out, so do the RipStick finisher in the garage or swap in 60 seconds of fast feet. Hard and clean.

moves.name: Push-ups
moves.body: Crisp reps, chest to floor. If you hit 30 early, hold high plank until the minute mark.

moves.name: Plank
moves.body: Elbows or hands. Ribs down, glutes on. Breathe slow.

moves.name: RipStick finisher
moves.body: Dom's RipStick (RipRight): hold sticks at chest → inhale and pull apart as wide as possible → with bands open, exhale and push arms straight out while keeping them apart (dynamic isometrics / Push-Pulls). Smooth continuous reps for the remaining time.

Tuesday is Mars's day (Tiw in the old Germanic calendar). In planetary magick Mars rules courage, cutting and decisive action: the sword that removes what doesn't belong.
The German shoemaker-mystic (1575-1624) said he saw the hidden structure of reality in sunlight glinting off a pewter dish. His lesson: the deepest insight can arrive in the plainest moment, at work.
The Emerald Tablet teaches that the small mirrors the large. Order your morning and you practice ordering your life; the pattern scales.
